author: trackreco
body:
Removes `RecoTracker/MkFitCore/standalone` and `RecoTracker/MkFitCMS/standalone`: 133 files, 23066 lines, as they stand on cms-sw master. Nothing else changes.

These trees hold the build of mkFit outside CMSSW: the driver programs, the interactive shell, the validation and benchmark scripts, and the Makefiles. scram never built them; neither tree has a `BuildFile.xml`. They move unchanged, at the same paths, to trackreco/mkFit-external. mkFit-external also becomes the place the standalone build runs from:

```
git clone https://github.com/trackreco/mkFit-external.git
(cd $CMSSW_BASE/src && git cms-addpkg FWCore/Utilities)   # the build includes it
mkdir standalone && cd standalone
../mkFit-external/configure $CMSSW_BASE/src
make -j 32
```

MkFitCore and MkFitCMS still include a few of these headers, always under `MKFIT_STANDALONE`, `MKFIT_TRACE` or `RNT_DUMP_MkF_SelHitIdcs`. No `BuildFile.xml` or python configuration defines these macros. The standalone build finds the headers in its mkFit-external checkout.

- Independent of the MkFinderV2p2 PR (link to follow): either can go first, and the two apply clean together.
- Not run: a scram build of this branch, since nothing it removes is built by scram.
title: mkFit: move the standalone build out of CMSSW, to trackreco/mkFit-external
